thread:
maria: Quick sync — finalizing command-center staffing and press coverage windows for the catalog onboarding next week. Need confirmations from marketing + SI leads by EOD.

```
- Command center ops checklist:

  2) Verify model routing fallback config (hosted -> dedicated)
  3) Confirm KMS key access for partner tenants
  4) Smoke test embeddings and generation endpoints
  5) Validate press landing page and GA tracking
```

alex: Marketing will freeze the landing page by Thu 17:00 PT. Tessa — can you provide a press quote + Q&A doc by Thu 12:00 PT?

tessa: Yes — I'll have quote, embargo language, and a short Q&A doc by Thu noon. Will upload to the shared drive. :white_check_mark:
